title: NASA: Lost Missions
subtitle: The journey ended. The evidence stayed.
tagline: A family-friendly interactive archive about the NASA hardware left behind on Mars and the Moon.

challenge.name: Abandoned but not Forgotten
challenge.full_name: Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars
challenge.description: Introduce families and school-age space enthusiasts to the hardware NASA left behind and the science it made possible.

idea.title: Every silent machine still has a scientific story.
idea.body: Lost Missions turns real NASA mission records into short interactive investigations. Players meet Spirit, Opportunity and Apollo 15's Lunar Roving Vehicle, identify the hardware, connect instruments to discoveries, and learn why each artifact stayed behind. Fictional framing and archive simulations are clearly separated from NASA data.

player_promise.title: Discover
player_promise.body: A real mission site introduces a machine that completed its work and stayed behind.

player_promise.title: Investigate
player_promise.body: The player connects instruments, engineering problems and discoveries while separating NASA data from simulations.

player_promise.title: Remember
player_promise.body: The final hardware card explains what the machine was, what it discovered, and what remains today.

mvp_scene.title: Three missions, three kinds of goodbye
mvp_scene.body: The MVP follows Spirit and Opportunity on Mars, then visits Apollo 15's abandoned Lunar Roving Vehicle and ALSEP on the Moon. Each mission combines a short playable investigation with a sourced hardware codex.

demo_beats: Arrive at a real NASA mission site.
Identify the hardware and the instruments it carried.
Connect a scientific clue to a discovery.
Play a clearly labeled simulation of an engineering problem.
Unlock a sourced hardware codex and the mission's emotional ending.

content_rules.label: NASA Data
content_rules.description: Verified mission facts must include a source link and be clearly attributed to NASA or the cited mission archive.

content_rules.label: Game Event
content_rules.description: Fictional framing and archive simulations cannot change the historical mission outcome.
